implementation_summary: requestSignal now returns { signal, release }. release() clears the deadline timer and removes the abort listener from the caller signal. Each provider's complete() calls release() in a finally. Tests narrow provider.complete via the withComplete helper (no non-null assertion, no suppression, no assertion removed) and add listener and timer cleanup tests.
evidence: tsc with packages/core/tests/tsconfig.typecheck.json: no errors in ai/timeout, ai/providers or ai-provider-timeout
risks: requestSignal's return type changed from AbortSignal to { signal, release }. Only the three providers and the BE-401 test file import it. Any later task that calls it must call release().
handoff: Use requestSignal(options) as { signal, release } and call release() in a finally. AITimeoutError and requestError are unchanged. There is no barrel change.
